Anika: Follow-up thread from today: drop single-line signals about why we won/lost and top asks so we can turn into action items.
Priya: Lost a healthcare pilot. Reason: needed SOC2 + evidence of encrypted-at-rest keys managed by their KMS. They also wanted a private deployment timeline.
Marco: Noted. We have Private on the roadmap but delivery estimate unclear. I'll add a short timeline and prerequisites.
Tomas: Win: ecommerce customer picked Dedicated for predictable tail latency during flash sales. They specifically cited our pre-warm and autoscale docs.
Jules: Pattern: multiple deals ask for easier quota management per team and per-route cost visibility. Small UI changes could unblock pilots.
Priya: Also pricing friction on pilots: customers want capped spend for trial periods. Suggest a trial-credit + cap flow in Console.
Anika: Agreed priorities: 1) KMS integration notes + SOC2 checklist, 2) Console caps for pilots, 3) per-route cost view. Marco/Tomas, scope and post ETAs by Friday.
Marco: Will scope minimal console changes and KMS docs.
Tomas: I'll coordinate with CS to collect affected customer names and add to the action doc.
all-hands-bot: Notes uploaded  https://redwood.company/notes/allhands-1767003333
Anika: Thanks. Keep updates short and paste them here.
